name: antigravity-starter-kit
description: Enterprise-grade toolkit for Antigravity AI agents featuring AI-Native SDLC, independent QA Agent testing, cross-layer verification, token economy, responsive mobile UX, programmatic hooks, and conventional commits.
author: Huy Vu
suggestedPrompts: /start-day Resume in-flight work or route by intent (feature, bug, brainstorm, docs)
/plan Design a new feature following the AI-Native SDLC workflow
/grill-me Stress-test a plan and resolve open design decisions
/define-tests Define black-box test cases and a cross-layer verification matrix from requirements
/tdd Develop with the Red-Green-Refactor loop at public seams
/improve-codebase-architecture Audit shallow modules and propose deepening opportunities
/review-code Audit security, inspect diffs, and verify against QA test cases
/seo audit Run a Technical SEO, Schema JSON-LD, and AI Search (GEO) audit
/modern-web Scan & apply Modern Web Platform & Web Baseline standards (Google Chrome)
